cues.en: Hi, in this video we are looking at how to explore and deploy the many models Foundry have to offer, and understand the different
cues.zh: 大家好，這支影片介紹如何探索與部署 Foundry 提供的各種模型，並了解不同的，

cues.en: deployment types, as it can be quite confusing to be honest.
cues.zh: 部署類型；老實說，這部分容易讓人混淆。

cues.en: I will show you how to deploy the models you have available, how to get access to restricted models and how to request more quota, so let's get started.
cues.zh: 會示範部署可用模型、申請受限模型存取權，以及提高額度的方法，開始吧。

cues.en: If we look at the model catalogue, you will see there are over 10,000 LLMs models to choose from, but in real life, unless you have a very niche scenario, you
cues.zh: 模型目錄裡有超過一萬個 LLM，但除非需求非常特殊，實際上，

cues.en: will only be dealing with a handful of the model providers and the model types.
cues.zh: 通常只會使用少數幾個供應商與模型類型。

cues.en: Foundry's most known models come from OpenAI, Anthropic, XAI, Mistral and DeepSeek.
cues.zh: Foundry 最常見的模型來自 OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Mistral 與 DeepSeek。

cues.en: The only big brand missing is Google Gemini, but that is to be expected, as Google and Microsoft are competitors in both the cloud
cues.zh: 主要品牌中缺少 Google Gemini，不過這很合理，因為 Google 與 Microsoft 在雲端，

cues.en: hosting and the AI space.
cues.zh: 與 AI 領域都是競爭對手。

cues.en: Microsoft themselves also have a few models on their own, but nothing revolutionary.
cues.zh: Microsoft 自己也有少數模型，但沒有特別革命性的產品。

cues.en: There's one special model called the model router.
cues.zh: 另外有一個特殊的 Model Router。

cues.en: It as such is not a model, but instead a collection of models that based on the question, can choose simpler or advanced models
cues.zh: 它本身不是單一模型，而是根據問題，從多個簡單或進階模型中，

cues.en: on the fly.
cues.zh: 動態選擇。

cues.en: I had a mixed result with this, so I tend to not use it personally, but it's an interesting idea and behind the scenes,
cues.zh: 我自己使用的結果好壞參半，所以通常不用，不過概念很有意思；背後，

cues.en: you can go in and choose which models it have available to route to.
cues.zh: 也能自行選擇可供路由的模型。

cues.en: Not all models are made for the same purpose.
cues.zh: 不同模型的用途不一定相同。

cues.en: Some do text, some do images, some do embeddings and some do speech, so it's a good thing to go in and check the
cues.zh: 有些處理文字、有些產生圖片、有些做嵌入向量或語音，因此應該查看，

cues.en: capabilities of each model as you go.
cues.zh: 各模型的能力。

cues.en: It's also not all models that work with the agents and workflow services, and since those
cues.zh: 也不是每個模型都能搭配 Agents 與 Workflows，而這個系列，

cues.en: are the ones we are going to focus on in this series, we will tend to stick with these models as you see on the screen.
cues.zh: 主要關注這些功能，所以通常會使用畫面上這些模型。

cues.en: Looking at a specific model, a description is there and a link to the pricing.
cues.zh: 點進模型，可以看到介紹與價格連結。

cues.en: While this screen is okay, I tend to instead go to the provider's own specific site as it gives more details and capabilities.
cues.zh: 這個畫面還可以，但我通常直接看供應商自己的網站，資訊與能力說明比較完整。

cues.en: Here is, for example, what GPT 5 have, and we can see features and pricing directly.
cues.zh: 例如這裡是 GPT-5，可以直接看功能與價格。

cues.en: I normally only use models that can do at least tool calling or function calling, as it's some kind called, and structured output, as
cues.zh: 我通常至少要求模型支援工具呼叫，也叫函式呼叫，以及結構化輸出，因為，

cues.en: I tend to use these features all the time.
cues.zh: 這些是我一直在用的功能。

cues.en: Beyond that, I look for at least an embedding model for VectorStore, and then I choose non-reasoning chat models and reasoning chat models
cues.zh: 另外至少選一個嵌入模型供向量儲存區使用，再準備非推理與推理模型，

cues.en: for the more advanced workloads.
cues.zh: 處理不同難度的工作。

cues.en: These are my go-to models as of December 2025, where GPT 4.1 and 4.1-mini
cues.zh: 截至 2025 年十二月，我常用的模型是 GPT-4.1 與 4.1 mini，

cues.en: is my non-reasoning, 5.1 and 5.1 Mini is for reasoning, and TextEmbedding 3.0 Small is for embeddings.
cues.zh: 作為非推理模型；5.1 與 5.1 mini 負責推理，text-embedding-3-small 負責嵌入向量。

cues.en: I am slowly getting rid of GPT 4.1 as it's quite pricey compared to how old it is, but it's really nice when
cues.zh: 我逐漸減少使用 GPT-4.1，因為相對它的年代，價格偏高；但如果，

cues.en: you just need to set up a model without needing to configure all the reasoning settings and so on.
cues.zh: 只是想直接使用模型，不想調整推理選項，它仍然很方便。

cues.en: Now let's dive into how to deploy a model, and you do that by clicking the model in the details page, and on the top, choosing the deploy button.
cues.zh: 接著看部署方式：進入模型詳細頁面，點選上方 Deploy。

cues.en: When you press that, there's a default settings and a custom settings.
cues.zh: 按下後，可以選預設或自訂設定。

cues.en: I will very much recommend you choose custom settings, because if you just press default, it just creates the model with no questions asked,
cues.zh: 我強烈建議自訂，因為預設會直接建立，不詢問細節，

cues.en: so it's better to go with the custom model, in my opinion.
cues.zh: 所以我認為自訂比較好。

cues.en: What you see is this sidebar that will pop up next to the deploy, where you give a deployment name, and this is special
cues.zh: 這時會出現側邊設定面板，先指定部署名稱；這是 Azure，

cues.en: for Azure in that you can choose your own name for the deployment, while, for example, in OpenAI, if you need to reference GPT
cues.zh: 比較特殊的地方，可以自行命名。OpenAI 要使用 GPT，

cues.en: 5.1, you need to give this name, but you could call this my model if you want to.
cues.zh: 5.1 就得填對應名稱，但這裡可以叫 MyModel。

cues.en: But I recommend that you don't change these names, because these are the ones the different providers show in their spec sheets and so
cues.zh: 不過我建議不要改，因為供應商文件與規格表使用的就是原本，

cues.en: on.
cues.zh: 那些模型名稱。

cues.en: Next, you choose a deployment type, and there are four different types.
cues.zh: 接著選部署類型，有四種。

cues.en: There's something called global standards, meaning that you get the cheapest pricing, the pricing you normally see on the spec sheets, but if you
cues.zh: Global Standard 通常價格最便宜，也就是規格表常見的價格，但你，

cues.en: can't rely on that, every call you do will stay within the Azure region that you have chosen.
cues.zh: 不能保證每次呼叫都只在所選 Azure 區域內處理。

cues.en: For a little more price, you can do data zone standard, which is within the Azure region's data zone.
cues.zh: 多付一點可以選 Data Zone Standard，處理範圍會限制在對應資料區域。

cues.en: And then there is provisioned version of this, where you get more reliability on your models, but you pay by the hour for each
cues.zh: 另外還有預先配置的版本，可靠度更高，但每個部署，

cues.en: of them, while global standard and data zone standard, you only pay when you use tokens.
cues.zh: 按小時計費；Global Standard 與 Data Zone Standard 則依實際 Token 用量計費。

cues.en: Beyond that, you can choose a model version.
cues.zh: 除此之外，可以選模型版本。

cues.en: There's often only one, but some of the older ones have older versions, and then some upgrade policies that it will automatically go to
cues.zh: 通常只有一個，但部分舊模型有多個版本，也能設定升級原則，自動，

cues.en: the newest version when they become available.
cues.zh: 切換到新版本。

cues.en: Then you choose your tokens per minute, and you might feel that you don't have enough tokens per minute, and if you don't, you
cues.zh: 接著設定每分鐘 Token 額度；如果覺得額度不足，

cues.en: need to go with quotas and raise them, as we'll talk about in a little bit.
cues.zh: 就得申請提高 Quota，稍後會介紹。

cues.en: The final thing is guardrails.
cues.zh: 最後是 Guardrails。

cues.en: There's the default, the default v2, and you can make your own guardrails as well, which we'll cover in a later video.
cues.zh: 有 Default、Default V2，也能自訂，後續影片會說明。

cues.en: So once you do this, you deploy it, and you end up with a model.
cues.zh: 完成後部署，就會得到一個模型。

cues.en: Certain models you can't press the deploy button on, and that is because some models are
cues.zh: 某些模型無法直接按 Deploy，因為，

cues.en: behind registration, meaning that you need to, it's often models that are under heavy use or
cues.zh: 它們需要先登記申請，通常是需求特別高，或，

cues.en: very resource intensive, because Microsoft in general, like everyone else, have a hard time keeping up
cues.zh: 非常耗費資源的模型；Microsoft 和其他供應商一樣，很難持續，

cues.en: with providing servers for all this load.
cues.zh: 提供足夠伺服器。

cues.en: So some of them are behind a request access, and when you press request access, you are taken to a website where you fill out a form.
cues.zh: 因此有些模型要先 Request Access，按下後會開啟申請表。

cues.en: You need to fill out your address details, your subscription ID, and why you need access to the model, and so on.
cues.zh: 需要填聯絡地址、訂閱 ID，以及為什麼需要這個模型等資訊。

cues.en: And it's a bit of a lottery, to be honest.
cues.zh: 老實說，有點像抽籤。

cues.en: Sometimes I have received after requesting access, a day after I get access, some I never get an answer back.
cues.zh: 有時申請隔天就取得權限，有時卻完全沒有回覆。

cues.en: And even if I'm on my private system, or I work with a company that have
cues.zh: 不論是我自己的帳號，還是有，

cues.en: dedicated Microsoft contacts and so on.
cues.zh: 專屬 Microsoft 聯絡窗口的公司，都遇過。

cues.en: The contacts I've spoken to is, say it's a come first, come serve model, which I don't believe when a Fortune 500 company comes
cues.zh: 窗口表示是先到先處理，但我不太相信，財星五百大的公司，

cues.en: along, they will probably push them up the length.
cues.zh: 大概還是比較容易被優先處理。

cues.en: I've also seen that sometimes I need to request, not here for a month, request again, and then I suddenly get it.
cues.zh: 我也遇過申請一個月沒消息，再送一次就突然通過。

cues.en: So it's not like it always works.
cues.zh: 所以不一定每次都順利。

cues.en: If you don't hear something in a couple of weeks, try and request again.
cues.zh: 如果等了幾週沒有消息，可以再申請。

cues.en: That is my recommendation.
cues.zh: 這是我的建議。

cues.en: Or at least speak to some Microsoft contacts that you have.
cues.zh: 至少也可以問問你認識的 Microsoft 聯絡窗口。

cues.en: But it is a real lottery when we have so few resources at the moment.
cues.zh: 目前資源有限，結果真的有點看運氣。

cues.en: Once you have your models, you can go to the build tab and then in the model section here, it will list your default different models.
cues.zh: 部署完成後，到 Build 的 Models，就能列出不同模型。

cues.en: And if you press them, you go into the playground, but also go to the details where you can edit.
cues.zh: 點進去可以開啟 Playground，也能到詳細資料編輯。

cues.en: So you can change the number of tokens and so on.
cues.zh: 例如修改 Token 額度等設定。

cues.en: You can delete your model, not that it costs you anything just by having it around.
cues.zh: 也能刪除模型；如果是隨用隨付的部署，單純保留通常不會收費。

cues.en: And again, if you find that you use a model and you constantly run out of tokens, you might want to request a quota.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，如果使用時常常碰到 Token 上限，就可能要申請提高額度。

cues.en: And a quota is, again, a website that you go to, fill out a form, tell
cues.zh: 同樣會前往一個網站填表，說明，

cues.en: why do you need it, how many thousands of tokens do you need instead.
cues.zh: 為什麼需要，以及希望增加多少千個 Token。

cues.en: And again, this is also a lottery.
cues.zh: 這又是另一種抽籤。

cues.en: I have tried the worst, trying to get more tokens for one of the models back in January and took three months before we
cues.zh: 我遇過最差的情況，一月申請增加某個模型的 Token 額度，等了三個月，

cues.en: got it.
cues.zh: 才核准。

cues.en: But I've also tried going here and the next day having many more tokens than I actually requested.
cues.zh: 也遇過隔天就取得比申請還多的額度。

cues.en: So again, go out early getting the quota if you need to go live at some
cues.zh: 所以如果未來要正式上線，請提早申請，

cues.en: point and ask for a lot because it can be really, really difficult.
cues.zh: 而且申請足夠額度，因為有時真的很難取得。

cues.en: And I have scenarios right now where we need to go to less capable models because
cues.zh: 我現在也有一些情境，被迫使用能力較弱的模型，

cues.en: we simply cannot get the quota for the high ones.
cues.zh: 因為拿不到高階模型所需的額度。

cues.en: But that is everything about models and model deployment.
cues.zh: 以上就是模型與模型部署。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
